alex: Quick evening handoff — short notes and action items before I sign off.
alex: What changed: small latency blip around 19:05 UTC impacting gen paths (p95 up ~120ms). No errors, just higher tails.
alex: Root cause candidate: KV cache evictions on redis-node-3 after a burst of prefill jobs. Eviction rate spiked ~4x.
sam: saw the grafana alert, digging into logs now — nothing throwing exceptions.
trina: canary deploys for model-routing are queued in eu-west, I'm watching the deploy window 20:00-22:00.
alex: Two PRs to note: #492 (model-routing reconcile) needs eng-runtime review; #501 (prefetch backoff tweak) needs perf signoff from Marco.
marco: I'll take #501, running tests in ~30m.
oncall-bot: Reminder: nightly infra maintenance 02:00-03:00 UTC — ephemeral nodes will be drained (ticket INF-3321).
sam: FYI no incident declared. If eviction rate goes >10k/s we should increase redis-cache memory or temporarily reduce prefill parallelism.
sam: quick mitigation command if needed:
```
curl -XPOST https://ops-api.internal/flags/cache -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"redis_cache_mb": 2048}'
```
trina: added a temporary alert on eviction rate at 8k/s and pinned a dashboard panel for the canary group.
alex: Action items: sam -> follow up on redis scaling + check persistence of eviction pattern; trina -> monitor canary + hold abort knob if errors; marco -> review/approve #501; alex -> update pagerduty notes and leave runbook link.
marco: noted, will review and comment in PR in ~45m.
sam: if the spike recurs after midnight, I'll escalate. For now I'm handing overnight watch to Sam.
alex: handing off to Sam for overnight coverage — briefed on watch thresholds and where to toggle flags.
sam: taking it, oncall mode enabled. Ping me in thread or DM if it moves beyond thresholds. :thumbsup: 
marco: thanks, everyone. Good handoff. :raised_hands:
